Final commit `b91e06f` on fix/seed-additive-repair (10 commits total, `4d4c7f1..b91e06f`), make check green.

1-2. CHANGELOG's two stale claims fixed exactly as specified (recorded-in-manifest clause; "only writes the global layer" → "never writes a repo-local archetype").

3. Steady-state UX: went with the code-side fix as instructed. `additiveMerge`'s "no missing keys explain the difference" reason is provably always benign by construction — it only fires when every shared key already agrees in value (checked earlier in the function) and existing has no extra key (checked earlier too) — so I renamed it to `"all shipped keys present; local formatting preserved"`. Updated `repairAdditive`'s doc comment, `docs/seed-content-upgrade.md`'s "why not recorded" section (was quoting the vaguer "reports a plain skip" instead of the real line — now quotes it verbatim), and the two pinned test assertions in `additive_test.go` (`TestAdditiveMerge_NoMissingKeysStaysUnmerged` now asserts the exact string; `TestPlace_UntrackedAdditiveDiffIsRepaired`'s run-2 assertion checks for "all shipped keys present").

Below-threshold note: added `TestAdditiveMerge_TrailingDocumentSeparatorStaysUnmerged` — confirmed live that `"name: x\n---\n"` (a trailing separator with nothing after it) correctly declines, since yaml's Decoder treats an empty second document as a real document, not `io.EOF`.

Re-dogfooded the steady state specifically: three consecutive `ethos seed` runs against the same repaired archetype — run 1 repairs, runs 2 and 3 both print `skipped (exists; beyond additive repair: all shipped keys present; local formatting preserved)`, no longer reading like an unresolved problem.

Branch not pushed, no PR. Standing by for close/correction.
